title: A client cancellation settles the task at TASK_STATE_CANCELED
rationale: Cancellation is a terminal transition the CLIENT causes, and it must be rendered as one: the task reaches TASK_STATE_CANCELED, the reason rides the status message, and the stream closes under the same terminal-close rule that ends a completed turn. A mapping that hung the connection up instead would be indistinguishable, client-side, from a crash. assert_active before the cancel keeps the vector honest about cancelling a LIVE task rather than a task that had already ended.

steps.note: the task must still be live for a cancellation to mean anything
